mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id, s.parent_session_id, s.session_name, s.session_content, s.session_type, s.create_time, s.creator_id, s.object_type, s.object_id, s.enterprise_id, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.state, r.avatar FROM byai_project_session ps INNER JOIN byai_session s ON ps.session_id = s.session_id LEFT JOIN ss_resource r ON s.object_id = r.resource_id WHERE ps.project_id = #{projectId} AND ps.delete_flag = '0' AND (s.state IS NULL OR s.state != 'DELETED') ORDER BY COALESCE(s.update_time, s.create_time) DESC, s.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM byai_project_session ps INNER JOIN byai_session s ON ps.session_id = s.session_id WHERE ps.project_id = #{projectId} AND ps.delete_flag = '0' AND (s.state IS NULL OR s.state != 'DELETED')
